controles.affirmation: Cybersecurite/DORA : "cette section, absente sous cette forme dans le rapport annuel precedent, traduit une exposition reglementaire en hausse plutot qu'un risque deja maitrise".
controles.verbatim_source: La section Third-party risk management est bien nouvelle en FY2025 : "Third-party risk management (TPRM) ensures a Group-wide approach... The approach takes into account the standards defined in the EU-wide Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA)" (rapport annuel FY2025). MAIS le rapport annuel FY2024 traitait deja DORA de facon substantielle, en indiquant la conformite atteinte : "The Group-wide gap analysis initiated at the end of 2023 was carried out within the framework of the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA), including the technical standards, and further measures were implemented to meet the regulatory requirements by mid-January 2025." DORA figurait meme dans les objectifs qualitatifs du Comite executif FY2024.
controles.correction_proposee: L'ajout d'une rubrique TPRM ne demontre pas une exposition reglementaire en hausse : le rapport FY2024 declare avoir mis en oeuvre les mesures pour repondre aux exigences DORA des mi-janvier 2025. Reformuler en fait neutre : "le rapport FY2025 introduit une rubrique dediee a la gestion des risques lies aux tiers, qui formalise le dispositif DORA deja engage depuis 2023", et retirer la conclusion "plutot qu'un risque deja maitrise".

controles.affirmation: "le resultat des commissions, lui, recule de 858 M CHF a 858 M CHF contre 870 M CHF en 2024 (-1% a taux de change constant)".
controles.verbatim_source: "Fee result: CHF 858 million (-1% in local currency)" et "The fee result came to CHF 858 million (FY 24: CHF 870 million)" (communique FY2025 du 12 mars 2026).
controles.correction_proposee: Defaut redactionnel : la phrase contient une duplication qui la rend incomprehensible ("recule de 858 M CHF a 858 M CHF"). Le fond est exact. Ecrire : "le resultat des commissions recule a 858 M CHF contre 870 M CHF en 2024 (-1% a taux de change constant)".

controles.affirmation: Le portefeuille suisse comporte un taux de conversion garanti de 6,8% sur sa partie obligatoire ; preuve citee : "the prevalent annuity conversion rate for the mandatory part of the occupational pension business is set at 6.8%".
controles.verbatim_source: Le texte reel dit : "the prevalent annuity conversion rate for the mandatory part of the BVG business is set at 6.8% for men (retirement age 65) and 6.8% for women (retirement age 65)" (URD FY2025 etats financiers, note 5.4.1). La phrase precedente confirme : "...(BVG) business of the group life insurance business in Switzerland is a significant part of the Group's overall life insurance business."
controles.correction_proposee: Le taux de 6,8% et le caractere significatif du portefeuille sont exacts, mais le verbatim entre guillemets a ete reecrit : "BVG business" a ete remplace par "occupational pension business" et les precisions hommes/femmes (age de retraite 65) supprimees. Restituer la citation exacte.

controles.affirmation: Flux nets TPAM : 4,2 Mds CHF au T1 2026 contre 9,3 Mds CHF au T1 2025 (-55%), vs un rythme annuel 2025 de 17,7 Mds CHF (+88% sur 2024, "une annee que Swiss Life qualifie elle-meme d'exceptionally high en comparaison").
controles.verbatim_source: Les chiffres sont exacts : "TPAM: net new assets: CHF 4.2 billion" (T1 2026) et "...in the first quarter of 2026 (prior-year period: CHF 9.3 billion), compared to an exceptionally high prior-year period" ; "TPAM: net new assets CHF 17.7 billion (+88%)" (FY2025). Mais l'expression "exceptionally high" qualifie le PERIODE COMPARATIVE T1 2025, pas l'exercice annuel 2025 ni 2024.
controles.correction_proposee: Rattacher la citation au bon perimetre : c'est le premier trimestre 2025 que Swiss Life qualifie d'"exceptionally high", pas l'annee. Le calcul -55% et la comparaison au rythme trimestriel moyen 2025 (17,7/4 = 4,4 Mds) restent valides.

controles.affirmation: Objectif Swiss Life 2027 : depasser 1 Md CHF de resultat des commissions d'ici 2027 ; taux de distribution vise superieur a 75% ; dividende 36,50 CHF (+4%) pour un benefice net stable a 1,26 Md CHF, taux de distribution 2025 de 82%.
controles.verbatim_source: "Swiss Life aims to increase its fee result to over CHF 1 billion by 2027 (FY 25: CHF 858 million)" ; "Swiss Life aims to achieve a dividend payout ratio of over 75% in each of the three years (FY 25: 82%) and to increase the dividend per share (FY 25: CHF 36.50, up 4% compared to the previous year)" ; "Net profit: stable at CHF 1.26 billion" (communique FY2025 du 12 mars 2026).

controles.affirmation: Le recul provient surtout du resultat de segment Asset Managers lie au TPAM (229 M CHF contre 254 M CHF), 2024 qualifiee d'exceptionnelle par le groupe.
controles.verbatim_source: Tableau FY2025 : "Segment result; 414 446 -7% - of which TPAM 229 254 -10%" ; "The segment result decreased by 7% to CHF 414 million, as the non-recurring TPAM income was below the very strong prior-year level."

controles.affirmation: Ratio SST estime a environ 210% fin mars 2026, nettement au-dessus de la fourchette strategique de 140 a 190%.
controles.verbatim_source: "Swiss Life estimates its SST ratio to be around 210% as at the end of March 2026 (31 December 2025: 213%). The solvency ratio is thus above the strategic ambition range of 140-190%." (communique T1 2026 du 21 mai 2026)

controles.affirmation: Suisse : primes +3% a 10,2 Mds CHF, resultat des commissions du segment fige a 55 M CHF, remise de tresorerie -12% a 651 M CHF (741 M CHF en 2024), repli lie a un element exceptionnel de 120 M CHF en 2024.
controles.verbatim_source: "In Switzerland, Swiss Life increased premiums by 3% to CHF 10.2 billion (FY 24: CHF 9.91 billion)... The fee result was stable at CHF 55 million... The cash remittance to the holding company was CHF 0.65 billion, CHF 0.09 billion below the previous year, which included a one-off of CHF 0.12 billion." (communique FY2025)
controles.correction_proposee: Note de forme : ce bloc fondamental_interne n'a aucun champ "preuve", contrairement aux autres. A ajouter.

controles.affirmation: Revenu direct des placements : 942 M CHF au T1 2026 contre 1 084 M CHF au T1 2025 (-13%), rendement non annualise 0,7% contre 0,8%, vs 2,9% sur l'ensemble de 2025 (stable vs 2024).
controles.verbatim_source: "Swiss Life generated direct investment income of CHF 942 million in the first quarter of 2026 (prior-year period: CHF 1084 million). The decline is due to lower income from infrastructure and equities, as well as foreign exchange rate movements. The non-annualised direct investment yield was 0.7% (prior-year period: 0.8%)." (T1 2026) ; "Direct investment income was stable at CHF 4.13 billion, which corresponds to a direct investment yield of 2.9% (FY 24: 2.9%)." (FY2025)

controles.affirmation: France : primes -2% en devise locale a 2,0 Mds EUR au T1 2026, vie -1% ; International -3% a 1,1 Md EUR.
controles.verbatim_source: "Swiss Life in France achieved EUR 2.0 billion in premiums, a decline of 2% in local currency. In the life business, premiums slightly decreased by 1%." ; "In the International market unit, premiums came to EUR 1.1 billion, 3% below the first quarter of 2025." (communique T1 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Precision mineure : le chiffre "2,05 Mds EUR un an plus tot" ne figure pas dans le communique, il est retrocalcule a partir du -2%.
